reviewQuestions: Are legal sources current and correctly mapped?
Are rule precedence and effective dates defensible?
Are legal limitations and escalation points explicit?
scope: application dates, transition periods, role applicability and exceptions
official-source allow-list and runtime legal-rule digest
decision-engine treatment of active, transitional and future rules

preReviewFindings.finding: The 2026 amendment and revised dates are implemented, but legal interpretation of amended Article 5 conditions and transitional scope remains unapproved.
preReviewFindings.requiredDecision: Confirm source mapping, legal effect, dates and exception wording.

preReviewFindings.finding: The registry intentionally uses simplified operational obligations rather than full statutory text.
preReviewFindings.requiredDecision: Confirm that each simplification preserves the legally material conditions and escalation boundary.

preReviewFindings.finding: Runtime evidence must be recaptured for the exact reviewed deployment SHA before acceptance can be credited.
preReviewFindings.requiredDecision: Require exact-SHA PASS evidence as a condition of any accepted opinion.

acceptanceCriteria: Every rule cites an authoritative source and correct provision.
Application and transition dates are correct for the reviewed version.
Exceptions and uncertain interpretations fail closed or escalate.
The signed decision is bound to the exact product SHA and package digest.
humanInputsRequired: EU AI Act counsel identity and registration
limitations: The registry is operational decision support, not an official consolidation of EU law.
National-law dependencies and customer facts remain outside this package.
No template or generated analysis is legal acceptance.
